units: Ratios except maximum accuracy drop in percentage points and times in seconds. Tail SD is within-run; summary sample SD is between training/scenario seeds inside each partition. Partitions are not treated as extra independent training seeds.
denominators: Population selection/completion coverage: all 100 logical clients. RAM denominator: static feasible RAM population (normally 60). Feasible coverage/Gini/staleness: clients with >=1 valid estimated-feasible opportunity, whose count and membership are policy-specific and exported. Completion Ginis are explicitly separated into population, RAM-feasible and feasible completion/opportunity versions.

fairnessMatching.definition: Coverage uses maximum absolute paired gap; selection/completion Gini and staleness use mean absolute paired gaps. Coverage and all other tolerances must pass; among qualified policies minimize selection-Gini gap, tie smaller lambda. Completion Gini here is feasible completion/opportunity Gini. This is an operational match, not statistical equivalence.
